# 📢 Sovereign Simulator v1.2.3 Release

Welcome to **Sovereign Simulator v1.2.3**! This major update focuses on quality-of-life enhancements for commanders and a massive survival upgrade for your minions: a seamless Neutral Standby mode for the Command Scepter, 3D aerial flight in Mining & Design modes, smart anti-fall ground-tracking for followers, intelligent mining storage auto-offloading, and a complete survival Never-Stall engine that eliminates building deadlocks forever.

---

## 🌟 Release Summary & Key Highlights

| Feature | Category | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Neutral Standby Mode (`DEFAULT`)** | Quality of Life | Keep your scepter held 24/7; open chests, doors, furnaces, and trade with villagers without interference. |
| **Aerial Flight in Mining & Design** | Exploration | Smooth 3D creative-style flight while holding the scepter to survey quarries and capture blueprints from above. |
| **Airborne Anti-Fall Ground-Tracking** | Minion Safety | Minions follow airborne commanders safely from the ground below with zero fall damage and strict lava refusal. |
| **Mining Storage Auto-Offload** | Logistics | Mining minions automatically offload mined blocks into nearby storages up to 128m away; drops items on ground if full. |
| **Never-Stall Survival Building** | AI Autonomy | Builders skip unavailable blocks temporarily using deficiency cooldowns, continuing work on ready tasks. |
| **In-World Tool Transformations** | Immersion | Builders craft and wield hoes, shovels, axes, and shears to till farmland, flatten paths, strip logs, and carve pumpkins. |
| **Multi-Tier Survival Crafting** | Crafting | Minions process multi-step recipes: paper, books, bookshelves, concrete, mud bricks, and redstone mechanisms. |
| **Exterior Water & Bucket Scavenging** | Logistics | Minions venture outside base barrier walls to collect water from rivers/lakes and scavenge buckets from village chests. |

---

## 📖 Detailed Changes & New Features

### 1. 🕊️ Neutral Standby Command Mode (`DEFAULT`)
- **Equip 24/7 Without Obstruction**: The Command Scepter now features a dedicated Neutral Standby mode (`DEFAULT`), allowing you to keep it held in your main hand or off-hand constantly without interfering with normal Minecraft gameplay.
- **Full Vanilla Interaction**: Right-clicking while in `DEFAULT` mode passes through cleanly, letting you open chests, barrels, doors, and trapdoors, use crafting tables, furnaces, and anvils, trade with villagers, breed animals, and eat food normally.
- **Easy Mode Switching**: Sneak + Right-Click in the air or press `V` at any time to cycle between operational modes or open the Scepter Command Hub.

---

### 2. 🦅 3D Arcane Aerial Flight (Mining & Design Modes)
- **Quarry Aerial Surveyor (`MINE` Mode)**: Hold the Command Scepter in Mining mode to take flight in Survival mode! Fly high above excavation sites to inspect quarry perimeters, slope angles, and depth progress with smooth 3D controls and safe touchdown landing.
- **Architect Aerial Surveyor (`DESIGN` Mode)**: Take flight while in Design mode to frame custom blueprint bounding boxes (`Pos1` and `Pos2`) and capture sprawling structures from high altitude without building temporary dirt towers.
- **Server-Side Safety**: Full server-side fall damage immunity and gentle descent ensure you touch down safely upon landing or switching modes.

---

### 3. 🛡️ Airborne Minion Ground-Tracking & Anti-Fall Teleportation
- **Anti-Fall Ground Projection**: When you fly high into the air, minions following you no longer spawn in mid-air and plummet to their deaths. If there is no safe 2x2 solid platform near your altitude, minions track you from the ground below—matching your (X, Z) coordinates directly onto safe terrain with zero fall distance.
- **Water Surface Landing**: If you hover over open water (lakes, oceans, rivers), minions safely teleport to the water's surface, using their innate water breathing and buoyant swimming.

## 📢 Sovereign Simulator v1.2.1 Release

Welcome to **v1.2.1**! This update gives you complete precision over what your minions mine, allows miners to dig independently in parallel without waiting around, drains flooded quarries, and smooths out building placement.

### 🌟 What's New & Player Highlights

- 🎯 **Selective Mining (Block Curation)**: You can now pick and choose exactly which blocks your minions will mine! Want to strip-mine only diamonds, coal, and iron while leaving the surrounding stone and dirt untouched? Or harvest only logs and leaves from a forest? Click **`[ 🎯 Curate Blocks ]`** in the mining confirmation window to pick your targets. In-world highlight grids will only show up on the blocks you chose!
- 💧 **Water, Lava & Clutter Clearing**: Minions now automatically scoop up water and lava inside your mining areas using buckets (even crafting buckets from iron ingots if needed) so your quarries don't stay flooded. They also clear away grass, flowers, and torches. In building mode, builders will also scoop away water puddles before placing solid structure blocks.
- ⚡ **Continuous Parallel Mining**: Minions digging in different spots now dig downward immediately at their own pace! They no longer freeze or wait idle for other minions to finish an entire horizontal layer across the quarry.
- 🏗️ **Seamless Blueprint Placement**: Fixed an issue where right-clicking near the ground to place a blueprint would accidentally trigger an Area Fill warning message. Blueprints now place smoothly and instantly wherever you click.
- 📦 **Smart Multi-Job Staging**: You can queue up mining areas, blueprints, and area fills right on top of each other (like clearing a hill and dropping a castle blueprint onto the exact same spot). Minions finish the excavation first, then seamlessly start building without interruptions.
- 🛏️ **Sleeping In Beds Works!**: Fixed the vanilla bug where beds placed by minions or captured from worlds claimed "This bed is occupied". You can now sleep in constructed beds immediately!

---

### 🎮 Installation Instructions

1. Download `fabric-mmcli-agent-modding-1.2.1.jar` below.
2. Place the jar file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Requires **Fabric Loader 0.16+** and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.21 (compatible with 1.21.x).

## [1.2.0] - 2026-10-15

### 🛡️ Sovereign Barrier Defense, Volumetric Area Fill, Unified Depth Excavation & Autonomous Threat Triage

### Added

#### ⚔️ AUTO Mode Danger-First Priority & Villager Medical Triage

- **Danger Elimination First (`WARRIOR`)**:
  - In `AUTO` mode, minions strictly prioritize eliminating danger above all else. If an auto minion is actively building or mining and a threat is detected (hostile mobs within 16m, minion/owner attacked, active target acquired, or scepter assault targets queued), the minion immediately shifts its adaptive role to **`WARRIOR`**.
  - `MinionBuildGoal` checks `evaluateAutoRole()` periodically every 5 ticks; when adapting away from `BUILDER`, it immediately stops execution, safely releases its claimed task back to the `ConstructionSession` (preventing lost work or skipped blocks), restores held weapons, and lands safely from Arcane Levitation to combat the threat.
  - Removed `isActivelyBuilding()` blocks from targeting goals (`TrackOwnerAttackerGoal`, `AttackWithOwnerGoal`, `RevengeGoal`) for `AUTO` minions, guaranteeing instantaneous retaliation and target tracking.
- **Comprehensive Medical Triage & Villager Healing (`SENTINEL`)**:
  - Once all threats and hostile entities are eliminated (or in peaceful conditions), the minion evaluates health for nearby allies within 16m (< 70% max health).
  - Explicitly integrated **Villagers (`VillagerEntity`)** into medical triage: minions now treat villagers as allied teammates (`isAlliedTeammate()`), detect wounded villagers within 16m (`hasNearbyAlliesNeedingHealing()`), adapt to `SENTINEL`, and channel _Aegis of Restoration_ (`SentinelHealAllyGoal`) with healing, Regeneration II, and heart particles.
  - Also covers player commanders, multiplayer allies, fellow squad minions, non-hostile Iron Golems, and self-healing for the minion itself when under 70% max health.
- **Seamless Return to Building / Mining (`BUILDER`)**:
  - Once all nearby allies and villagers are healed to 70% max health or higher AND no threats exist, the auto minion automatically adapts back to **`BUILDER`**.
  - Scans for the nearest active construction or mining session within 128 blocks via `ConstructionManager`, claims the next task in strict FIFO order, takes flight with Arcane Levitation, and resumes work.

#### ⛏️ Unified In-World Height & Underground Depth Controls (Mining & Area Fill Modes)

- **Unified Bi-Directional Vertical Controls (`ClientMiningCaptureTracker`, `ClientBuildCaptureTracker`)**:
  - Eliminates the need to dig down underground to set the bottom corner of an excavation or area fill selection.
  - Decreasing the selection height past 1 block at the baseline surface layer (`initialBaseY`) automatically expands the volume **downward into the ground**.
  - Increasing height shrinks underground depth back toward the surface and seamlessly crosses over into upward above-ground expansion.
  - Strictly limited to **Mining Area** (`MINE` mode `AREA` sub-mode) and **Build Area Fill** (`BUILD` mode `AREA` sub-mode); custom blueprint capture (`DESIGN` mode) remains strictly upward-oriented.
- **Underground Actionbar Feedback & HUD Depth Indicators**:
  - Live HUD actionbar and modal labels display clear depth tracking (`[↓ Xb deep]`) when expanded underground while preserving dimension strings.
  - Updated `MiningConfirmModalScreen` and `BuildAreaConfirmModalScreen` button tooltips and labels (`[-5]`, `[-1]`, `[+1]`, `[+5]`) to reflect underground expansion and reduction.
- **Bedrock & Height Limits Safety Safeguards**:
  - Safely clamps underground expansion to `world.getBottomY()` (down to $Y = -64$) and `MAX_HEIGHT = 96` blocks.
  - Hologram rendering (`BlueprintHologramRenderer`) projects seamlessly below terrain surface with zero visual clipping.

# ⚔️ Sovereign Simulator v1.1.0 — The Architecture & Stealth Update

Welcome to **v1.1.0** of **Sovereign Simulator**! This major update brings powerful new tools for architects, covert stealth tactics for stealthy commanders, smarter battlefield preservation for your garrisons, and buttery-smooth performance across massive builds.

Here is everything new, improved, and fixed in this update:

---

### 🎨 Swap & Customize Blueprint Blocks on the Fly
Tired of capturing a build and being stuck with its original blocks? You can now customize materials before building!
* **In-Viewer Block Swapping (`[ 🎨 Remap ]`)**: While browsing any blueprint in the 3D Architectural Explorer, hit the new **Remap** button to view every block type in the structure. Pick any block and swap it for another—turn cobblestone ruins into polished stone brick castles, or swap oak planks for spruce!
* **The "Air" Eraser Tool**: Want to remove scaffolding, spiderwebs, temporary dirt, or weeds from your blueprint? Map that block to Air to cleanly erase it from the build plan—your minions won't ever place or require it.
* **Architectural Smart Preservation**: When you swap stairs, slabs, logs, or fences, they automatically remember their rotation, direction, and shape so your roofs and pillars don't look weird or misaligned.
* **Save Choice**: Choose to **Overwrite** the blueprint or **Save as a Copy** so you can keep the original while creating material variants!
* **Updated Resource Estimator**: Any swapped blocks immediately update in the Survival Bill of Materials (BOM), showing your builders' exact new supply needs.

---

### 🥷 Squad Stealth & Synchronized Minion Sneaking
Take your tactical operations underground or sneak past enemy territory without blowing your cover!
* **Mirror Crouch**: When you hold **`Shift`** to crouch, all your selected minions immediately crouch with you in real time.
* **Squad Escort Stealth**: Minions assigned to protect a Squad Leader will now crouch whenever their squad leader crouches.
* **Total Name Tag & Badge Concealment**: While sneaking, all overhead health hearts, squad badges, role crests, and name tags completely vanish from view.
* **Matched Creep Pacing**: Crouching minions slow down to match your exact sneaking walking pace, keeping formation tight without bumping or overrunning you. If they fall too far behind, they safely jog forward while staying crouched.

---

### ⚔️ Smarter Mass Assaults (Guards Stay at Their Posts!)
Using the Scepter's 90-degree forward rally cone (Banner of Courage) to sweep over enemy mobs is now much smarter and less disruptive:
* **Target Enemy Mobs Without Disbanding Your Base**: When you highlight monsters in the cone, combat-ready minions charge into battle—**without** abandoning their assigned guard posts or patrol routes!
* **Automatic Return to Post**: Stationary guards return to their guard posts after eliminating the threat.
* **Uninterrupted Patrols**: Minions on patrol routes engage the enemies, then smoothly snap back to their patrol routes once the area is clear.
* **Free Roamers Stay Free**: Ambient roaming minions return to wandering peacefully once combat ends.

---

### 🛡️ Sentinels Gain Supernatural Hearing Through Walls
Monsters hiding in bunkers, caves, or around corners will no longer catch your base off guard!
* **Wall-Penetrating Sentry Senses**: Sentinels stationed on guard posts can now detect and target hostile mobs lurking behind solid walls, closed doors, floors, and ceilings (up to 24 blocks horizontally and 12 blocks vertically).
* **Atmospheric Audio & Visual Cue**: When a Sentinel senses an obscured enemy, it turns toward the sound with teal soul particles, resonant amethyst chimes, and sculk clicking sounds.
* **Base Defense Mobilization**: When a Sentinel detects a hidden threat, nearby idle combat allies automatically mobilize to intercept and investigate!

---

# ⚔️ Sovereign Simulator: Arcane Strategy & Engineering — Version 1.0.1

Welcome to **Sovereign Simulator v1.0.1**! This update brings a massive visual upgrade to blueprint building, makes combat more impactful, gives you full control over who your minions fight, and completely solves minion pathfinding and wall-suffocation issues.

---

## ✨ What's New in Version 1.0.1

### 🔍 Brand New 3D Blueprint Explorer
Inspect every building before placing it down with our brand-new interactive 3D viewer!
- **True 3D Preview**: Spin, rotate, and zoom into full 3D models of any blueprint right inside the Command Hub.
- **Crystal-Clear View**: Hidden interior blocks are smoothed out so you see clean, beautiful walls and rooflines instead of cluttered lines.
- **Floor Cutaway Slicer**: Peek inside multi-story houses and towers! Step floor-by-floor from ground level to the roof to check out rooms, furniture, and stairs.
- **Fullscreen Mode**: Hit `Tab` or press the expand button (`[ ⛶ ]`) to view your creations on an expansive cinematic preview screen.
- **Vibrant Colors & Real Plants**: Flowers, crops, wood rings, workstations, and colored blocks now display in their authentic Minecraft colors instead of generic gray stone blocks.
- **Instant Search**: Type in the search bar to find any building in your catalog in seconds.

### ⚔️ Mighty Frontline Warriors (+4 Damage Boost)
Warriors are now true frontline bruisers:
- **Massive Attack Boost**: Warrior minions deal **+4 extra damage** with every hit (a bare fist does 9 damage; an Iron Sword hits for 15 damage; a Diamond Sword hits for 16 damage!).
- **Critical Hits & Knockback**: Land devastating critical strikes that send enemies flying with dramatic combat particles and sound effects.

### 🎯 Custom Target Filters & Safety Presets
Take complete command over which enemies your army attacks:
- **Searchable Monster List**: Easily pick and choose which mobs your minions target.
- **One-Click Presets**:
  - **All Hostiles**: Attack all monsters on sight.
  - **Creeper Safe**: Minions ignore Creepers so your base never gets blown up by accidental explosions!
  - **Undead Only**: Focus down Zombies, Skeletons, Phantoms, Drowned, Husks, and Withers.
  - **Raiders**: Defend villages against Pillagers, Ravagers, and Witches.
  - **Passive**: Pacifist mode where minions never start fights.
- **Save Your Favorites**: Create and save your own custom targeting presets with one click.

### 🛡️ Individual Minion Combat Stances
Customize how each minion acts on the battlefield:
- **Global**: Follows the army's general battle rules.
- **Defensive**: Only fights back when attacked or when protecting you.
- **Passive**: Never attacks, perfect for peaceful builders and workers.
- **Custom**: Assign specific enemy target lists to specific squad members.

### 🧱 Smarter Minions: No More Getting Stuck!
- **Safe Evacuation**: When clearing out quarries or underground mining tunnels, minions will no longer get stuck in walls or rock ceilings. They safely exit to the surface or stand on solid floor.
- **Emergency Unstuck Rescue**: If a minion ever gets pushed into a solid wall or caught in falling gravel, they will automatically teleport safely to open ground.
- **Smooth Walking**: Minions no longer stutter or glitch when walking up stairs, slabs, snow layers, or path blocks.

### 🏗️ Seamless Team Building
- **Faster Construction**: Minions working together on the same building now share tasks dynamically. If a worker gets distracted or delayed, other nearby minions will jump in and finish the job without pausing.
- **Sticky Blueprints**: Placing down a blueprint now keeps it selected on your Command Scepter so you can build multiple structures quickly without re-selecting.

---

## 🎮 How to Use the New Features

1. **Open the 3D Blueprint Explorer**:
   - Hold your **Command Scepter**, switch to **BUILD** mode, and open the Command Hub (`V` key or Shift + Right-Click).
